items.title: Visa to close Crossmint memecoin rewards loophole following The Block investigation: report
items.summary: Though the Crossmint-powered memecoin sales are still live on both apps, Visa's grace period is expected to end next week, per the report.

items.title: Grayscale Is Making Its Red-Hot Zcash ETF More Affordable
items.summary: The Zcash ETF is splitting its shares three ways after pulling in more than $233 million in under a month, as Wall Street piles into crypto's hottest privacy trade.

items.title: 'We have lost control': Crypto pioneer warns AI could trigger systemic banking and infrastructure shocks
items.summary: Marc van der Chijs sold much of his bitcoin to invest in AI.

items.title: Bastion wins conditional OCC approval for national trust bank charter
items.summary: Bastion Platforms National Trust Company will offer stablecoin custody and wallets, payment infrastructure and white-label issuance from a single federally regulated entity.
